paite: Huan hinna tui lui Kristal suang banga te, Pathian leh Belamnou laltuphaha hongsuak khia tuh a honen sakta a,
english: He showed me a TR adds “pure” river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of God and of the Lamb,

paite: Huai a kongzing laia huan a lui lang tuaktuak ah, hinna sing gah chi sawm leh nih nei, kha tenga gah tuh a oma: huan huai sing nahte tuh namte hihdamna ding ahi a.
english: in the middle of its street. On this side of the river and on that was the tree of life, bearing twelve kinds of fruits, yielding its fruit every month. The leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.

paite: Huan hamsia himhim a om nawn kei dinga; huan huailaiah tuh Pathian leh Belamnou laltutphah a omta ding hi: huan a sikhaten ama na a sem ding ua;
english: There will be no curse any more. The throne of God and of the Lamb will be in it, and his servants serve him.

paite: Huan amau tuh a mel a mu ding ua; huan amah min tuh a tal uah a om ding hi.
english: They will see his face, and his name will be on their foreheads.

paite: Huan jan himhim a om nawn kei dia; huan khawnvak vak leh ni vak hiam leng a deih nawn kei ding uh; Toupa Pathianin amau vakna a piak ding jiakin: huan amau tuh khantawn khantawnin vai a hawmta ding uhi.
english: There will be no night, and they need no lamp light; for the Lord God will illuminate them. They will reign forever and ever.

paite: Huan aman tuh a kiangah, Hiai thute a muanhuai un a dik uhi: huan Toupa jawlnei siangthou te Pathianin, thil hong om pah mahmah dingte a si khate kiangah mu sak dingin, a angel a sawlta hi.
english: He said to me, “These words are faithful and true. The Lord God of the spirits of the prophets sent his angel to show to his bondservants the things which must happen soon.”

paite: Huan ngaiin, Kong pai pah ding. a chi a. Hiai laibu a genkholh nate a jui peuh mahte a hampha hi,
english: “Behold, I come quickly. Blessed is he who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book.”

paite: Huan kei Johan tuh hiai thilte zapa leh mupa ka hi a. Huan huchia ka jak a, ka muh takin, hiai thilte hon musakpa angel khe bul ah be ding in ka pukta hi.
english: Now I, John, am the one who heard and saw these things. When I heard and saw, I fell down to worship before the feet of the angel who had shown me these things.

paite: Huan aman tuh ka kiangah, Honbe kei hial in, hiai laibu thute kem leh na unau jawlneite leh nang sikha hihpih ka hi: Pathian be jaw in, a chi a.
english: He said to me, “See you don’t do it! I am a fellow bondservant with you and with your brothers, the prophets, and with those who keep the words of this book. Worship God.”

paite: Huan aman tuh ka kiangah, Hiai laibu a genkholhnate bilh khumta ken, a hun a naitak jiakin.
english: He said to me, “Don’t seal up the words of the prophecy of this book, for the time is at hand.

paite: Kuapeuh mi diktatlouin diktatlouhna hih nalai hen; huan kuapeuh mi nin, nin nalai hen: huan kuapeuh mi keizenin, kizenna hih nalai hen: huan kuapeuh mi siangthou tuh, siangthou nalai hen.
english: He who acts unjustly, let him act unjustly still. He who is filthy, let him be filthy still. He who is righteous, let him do righteousness still. He who is holy, let him be holy still.”

paite: Ngaiin, ka hong pai pah ding; huan a thil hih bang jel ua piak dingin ka kiang ah ka kipahman a om hi.
english: “Behold, I come quickly. My reward is with me, to repay to each man according to his work.

paite: Alpha leh Omega ka hi, a masapen leh a nanungpen, a bul leh a tawp.
english: I am the Alpha and the Omega, the First and the Last, the Beginning and the End.

paite: Hinna sing a honzot theihna ding uleh, konga khopi sunga a lut theihna ding ua, a puan uh sawp siangte tuh a hampha uhi.
english: Blessed are those who do his commandments, NU reads “wash their robes” instead of “do his commandments”. that they may have the right to the tree of life, and may enter in by the gates into the city.

paite: A polam ah uikhawng, leh bumhatte leh, mingaihhatte leh tualthatte leh milimbete leh kuapeuh juau thu deih a, juau thu bawlte a om uhi;
english: Outside are the dogs, the sorcerers, the sexually immoral, the murderers, the idolaters, and everyone who loves and practices falsehood.

paite: Kei Jesuin saptuamte adinga hiai thilte na kiang ua hontheisak dingin ka angel kon sawlta hi. David zung leh a suan, jingsolaksi, vak ka hi, a chi a.
english: I, Jesus, have sent my angel to testify these things to you for the assemblies. I am the root and the offspring of David; the Bright and Morning Star.”

paite: Huan Kha leh Mouin, Hongpai in, a ci ua. Huan kuapeuh a jain. Hongpai in chi, hen. Huan kuapeuh a utin hinna tui a manbeiin hongdawn hen.
english: The Spirit and the bride say, “Come!” He who hears, let him say, “Come!” He who is thirsty, let him come. He who desires, let him take the water of life freely.

paite: Hiai laibua genkholhna thute zapeuh kiangah ka thiesak hi: Mi kuapeuh in hiai thute a behlap ualeh Pathian in amau tungah hiai laibua a kigelh gawtna tuh behlap inteh:
english: I testify to everyone who hears the words of the prophecy of this book, if anyone adds to them, may God add to him the plagues which are written in this book.

paite: Huan kuapeuh in hiai genkholhna laibua thute lakmang a neih leh, Pathian in amau tan ding, hiai laibu a kigelh, hinna sing a kipan leh, kho siangthou a kipanin lamang inteh.
english: If anyone takes away from the words of the book of this prophecy, may God take away his part from the tree of life, and out of the holy city, which are written in this book.

paite: Hiai thilte theisakpa, aman, Ahi: ka hongpai pah ding, a chi. Amen Hongpaiin, Toupa Jesu.Toupa Jesu hehpihna tuh misiangthoute kiangah omta hen. Amen.
english: He who testifies these things says, “Yes, I come quickly.” Amen! Yes, come, Lord Jesus.

paite: Toupa Jesu hehpihna tuh misiangthoute kiangah omta hen. Amen.
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with all the saints. Amen.
